title: FitLog - Fitness Tracking Application
description: A responsive fitness application designed to help users explore workouts, track exercises, and organize personal fitness plans.
challenges: Building a responsive interface for different screen sizes
Organizing workout information into reusable components
Connecting the frontend with API data

title: Bazar Dor - Product Price Comparison
description: A Bangla-focused product information and price comparison website that helps users explore products and compare prices across different markets.
challenges: Displaying product information in a user-friendly layout
Integrating API data into reusable components
Creating responsive product and category navigation
future: Add advanced product search and filtering
Add product price history and tracking

title: DevStack - Developer Tech Stack Builder
description: A web application where users can explore different development technologies, organize tools, and build their own custom tech stack with responsive UI components.
challenges: Managing dynamic state transitions when selecting and removing technologies
Creating an intuitive and responsive UI layout using Tailwind CSS and DaisyUI
Structuring reusable components and managing props cleanly in TypeScript
future: Support saving and exporting customized stacks via local storage
Provide detailed documentation and version insights for each technology
